source.history: Q_e(W,t)=t*A(W), t in [0,1e10] s, initially empty; unchanged leading local H*t source approximation.

atomic_model.excitation_cost: native first-zero marker adopted effective model cost; no experimental spectroscopy certificate

atomic_model.ionization: NIST BEB total with normalized BED slow-electron energy-sharing shape, per NIST intro B and equations 1,3,4; exact coefficients and CGI normalization/domain must be pinned before final execution.
atomic_model.ionization_daughters: W and E-B-W, with W in [0,(E-B)/2]; one extra free electron per event

coulomb.closure: superthermal equal-electron leading-log continuous slowing down into prescribed bath
coulomb.matched_low_energy: exactly retains PHYS02A classical log below 10 eV
coulomb.preselected_sensitivity: replace Lquantum by Lquantum - 1/2; model sensitivity, not certified physical error
coulomb.reference: FS10 Eq12, Krommes2018 Eqs5,14 and classical/quantum matching discussion; dynamic bmax from inherited fast stopping closure

numerics.variables: energy-weighted electron nodes E_j*N_j plus disjoint absorbing energy reservoirs and number/low-boundary counters
numerics.projection: nonnegative piecewise linear in energy, preserves electron count and energy; below 0.1 eV retain actual kinetic energy; near-cutoff grid projection documented
numerics.drift: downward first-order conservative jump approximation; rate b(E_j)/(E_j-E_prev), heat is energy difference
numerics.birth_projection: cell-split Gauss quadrature and same energy/count-conserving projection
numerics.ionization_projection: BED quadrature split at all daughter projection knots; both daughters retained; discrete normalization correction recorded separately from physical NIST normalization
numerics.time: sparse matrix exponential of source-ramp augmented linear system; initially zero; u=t/1e10
numerics.refinement_if_needed: double cells until fixed tolerances are met; no tolerance relaxation
numerics.low_grid: uniform from ghost cutoff0.1 to10, upper endpoints active
numerics.terminal_reference: mathematical resolvent of same frozen generator, not an evolution outside the source validity window

reference_independence: Parent analytic Ei low solution independently derived previously; direct Rudd SDCS versus coefficient path; source table/CGI versus implemented equations; exact branching toy; solve_ivp shares generator and tests time propagation only; refinement shares physics and does not certify physical accuracy.
